guide_passage:
The r4 guide's passage (the passage this carries):
Spiritual openings also happen out of order. Somebody may encounter God, nibbāna, ego death, an extraordinary heart opening, or another profound realization long before they have built a reliable inner Nurturer or Protector. The realization may be completely genuine. It may also show them a depth of peace, freedom, or love that they did not previously know was possible.

The integration question comes afterward.

Did what you discovered deepen or widen love? Can that love reach the frightened, ashamed, angry, or abandoned parts of you? Does it make you more truthful, protective, reliable, compassionate, and capable of relationship?

Don’t let mystery outrun love indefinitely.
brief:
- the main point: after a spiritual opening that came out of order, the integration question is whether it deepened or widened your love, and whether it makes you more truthful, protective, reliable, compassionate and capable of relationship.
- what the dedup leaves to add (groups 15 and 16): only whether the opening deepened or widened love (G16.2) and the qualities test (G16.4). Group 15 (openings out of order, genuine, showing a love you didn't know) is all in the article already ([B16] to [B20], [B111], [B120], [B196]), and so are love reaching the frightened parts and mystery outrunning love; a short pointer back is fine, not a retelling.
- stance: the realization may be completely genuine (don't doubt the opening itself).
